en.headline: Hong Kong Wine and Dine Festival draws crowds on final day at Central Harbourfront
en.dek: The four-day event organised by the Tourism Board ends today, with exhibitors reporting sales growth and Guangdong industry visitors attending.
body: The Hong Kong Wine and Dine Festival, organised by the Hong Kong Tourism Board, reached its final day on Sunday at the Central Harbourfront Event Space and Tamar Park, attracting large numbers of local residents and visitors.

The event ran from 29 October to 1 November and featured more than 340 booths showcasing wines and cuisine from around 30 countries and regions, including new pavilions from Australia and South Korea. Opening hours on Sunday were from 1pm to midnight.

Reports noted positive sales for some exhibitors on the closing day, with representatives from Guangdong industry attending to observe the format. The Tourism Board has said a Hong Kong Gourmet Month will follow in November with citywide dining offers.

zh.headline: 香港美酒佳餚巡禮閉幕日吸引大批市民遊客
zh.dek: 旅發局主辦的四日活動今日結束，部分展商銷情錄得增長，廣東業界人士進場觀摩。
body: 由香港旅遊發展局主辦的香港美酒佳餚巡禮周日進入閉幕日，在中環海濱活動空間及添馬公園舉行，吸引大批市民及遊客。
活動由10月29日至11月1日舉行，設超過340個攤位，匯集約30個國家及地區的美酒美食，包括澳洲及南韓新展館。周日開放時間為下午1時至午夜。
有報道指部分展商在閉幕日銷情錄得增長，廣東業界代表亦進場取經。旅發局表示11月將推出香港美食月，延續餐飲優惠。
